originality.rationale: Searches and direct implication comparisons show no known result deriving the maximal all-order second-mode locking interval for the circular (lambda+n^2)^(-s) spectrum. The closest 2026 modulation theorem is for a geodesic exponential with an alternating-parity Fourier factor; the 2019 and 2020 primary Matérn papers construct and analyze covariance spectra but do not give the present signed-mask criterion. The earlier own fractional-exponential and Poisson-mixture claims have different coefficient ratios. This is a bounded best-knowledge judgment with remaining historical-priority risk.

value.rationale: The exact maximal mass-parameter interval where the same interior Fourier obstruction uniquely controls positivity for every fractional smoothness is a natural structural invariant of circular Bessel/Matérn spectra. It distinguishes the first- and third-mode failure mechanisms at the two endpoints and yields an explicit sign-tolerant covariance design boundary with a nonuniversal but strictly positive-definite spectral notch. It is neither a generic multiplier rearrangement nor a selected numerical parameter computation.
